New York: De Beers made its first payment into the fund meant to diversify Botswana's diamond economy.

De Beers transferred BWP 1 billion, its initial contribution, to the Diamonds for Development Fund, now governed by a ten-person board chaired by Dr Akinwumi Adesina.

Al Cook, De Beers CEO: We will continue to invest to ensure the future success of Botswana's diamond industry.

Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
